Exporting Data

Save your analysis results in various formats for further processing and publication.

Export Options Overview

IFU Analyzer provides several export capabilities:

What to Export

Format

Purpose

Spectrum

Text (.txt, .csv)

Further analysis

Slice, masked slice, cube

FITS

One slice, or the cube outside a region set to NaN

Region

Text

The sky coordinates of a region, for reuse on another cube (Selecting Regions)

Continuum cubes

FITS

The continuum and the continuum-subtracted cube

Gaussian Fit Maps

FITS

Imaging analysis tools

Flux Map

FITS

The flux map and the detection map

Rotational diagram

CSV, FITS and PNG

Line fluxes, and the temperature maps

2D viewer images

FITS, text, ZIP

Rotated images, contours, and matched images

Visualization

PNG, JPEG, PDF

Slices and other 2D data

Exporting Spectra

Text Format

Export the displayed spectrum as tab-delimited text:

  1. Select the tab (Full, Left Region, or Right Region) that you want to save

  2. Click Save Spectrum, under the spectrum plot

  3. Specify a filename with a .txt or .csv extension

  4. The file starts with header lines that give the instrument, the tab, and the units. Then the columns follow:

# Results Export from Cube Explorer
# Instrument: MIRI
# Spectrum tab: full
# Type: full_results
# Wavelength unit: um
# Flux unit: MJy/sr
#
# Wavelength (um)    Original    Continuum    Subtracted
4.500000e+00    1.234000e+01    nan    nan
4.501200e+00    1.241000e+01    nan    nan
...

The Continuum and Subtracted columns hold values only after you fit a continuum for that tab (Continuum Subtraction). Without a continuum, they are NaN.

Exporting Slices, Regions, and Cubes

The Export and Region groups in the toolbar hold the buttons for slices, cubes, and regions. Each button first asks which slice, Left or Right, to use.

  • Save Slice: the current slice as a standalone 2D FITS file

  • Save Slice (Masked): the same, with everything outside the region set to NaN

  • Save Cube (Masked): the whole cube, with everything outside the region set to NaN

  • Save Region and Import Region: a region as RA/Dec sky coordinates in a text file, and the way back (Selecting Regions)

Exporting Continuum Cubes

Save Continuum Cubes (in the Continuum Tools group) writes two FITS cubes: <name>_continuum.fits and <name>_contsub.fits (Continuum Subtraction).

Exporting Gaussian Fit Maps

Export Gaussian Fitting Results

Save maps created from pixel-by-pixel cube fitting:

  1. In the “Gaussian Parameter Maps” window, select the map in the Parameter dropdown

  2. Click Save as FITS File

  3. Specify filename

Each map is a single-slice FITS file. The Residuals map is saved as a 3D cube (Pixel-by-Pixel Cube Fitting).

Exporting Flux Maps and Rotational Diagrams

  • Flux Map: in the results window, click Export as FITS to save the map that is displayed (Flux Extraction).

  • Rotational diagram: Save Fluxes writes the line table as a CSV file, and Import from CSV reads it back. Save Maps writes the maps as FITS and PNG files in one ZIP file (Rotational Diagram).

Exporting from the 2D Viewer

  • Save FITS (on each panel): the image, with its updated WCS header, for example after a rotation

  • Save in the Contour group: the contours as a text or CSV file

  • Pair and Batch: the matched images as FITS files, or as one ZIP file for Batch (2D FITS Dual Image Viewer)

Image Export Formats

Export intensity map as image:

  1. Display desired map/wavelength

  2. Click on the Save icon under every visualization
